publication: GitHub connector used because local git HTTPS credential helper has no cached account. Published source trees are compared with locally tested Git trees; canonical commits are fetched into the local checkout.

change.resources: Use existing run_numa discovery of allowed physical cores per NUMA, split among ranks_per_numa. No fixed 37-thread runtime or profile.
change.thread_resolution: Solver threads=None inherits launcher rank-local OMP_NUM_THREADS; fine kernels read omp_get_num_threads at each call.
change.partition: base=N/T, extra=N%T; thread t starts at base*t+min(t,extra), length base+(t<extra). All T threads receive work when N>=T; lengths differ by at most one.
change.tail: SIMD range tails remain masked/clipped; no padding memory is accessed.

coverage.partition_audit: Larger teams audited deterministically; actual OpenMP unit teams capped at 37. All sites visited once, empty/small ranges and EO/color subsets checked.

usage.requirements: Omit --threads from launcher; construct Solver with threads=None. For multiple ranks per NUMA use --ranks-per-numa; allowed physical cores are partitioned among those ranks. Retain MPI t-slab aggregate divisibility requirements.
